# Icon Monks

> 70,000+ free, open source icons in six weights (thin, light, regular, bold, fill, duotone), drawn on one 256-unit
> grid, with packages for React, Vue, Web Components, an icon font, SVG, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose. MIT
> licensed. A product of Design Monks.

## Facts

- What it is: a free, open source (MIT) icon library made by Design Monks, a product design studio founded by Atiqur Rahaman.
- Icons: 6,054 unique icons in 31 categories, each in six weights (36,324 SVG files).
- Grid: every icon is a single path on a 256-unit grid; outline strokes are 8, 12, 16 and 24 units.
- Current version: 0.4.2, released 2026-10-28.
- License: MIT, free for personal and commercial use, no attribution needed in your interface.
- Contact: hello@iconmonks.co
- About: https://www.iconmonks.co/about/

## Install

- React: `npm install @icon-monks/react`
- Vue 3: `npm install @icon-monks/vue`
- Web Components: `npm install @icon-monks/web`
- Icon font: `npm install @icon-monks/font`
- SVG files and helpers: `npm install @icon-monks/core`
- Flutter: `flutter pub add icon_monks`
- SwiftUI: Swift Package Manager, https://github.com/designmonks-llc/icon-monks
- Android: `implementation("com.github.designmonks-llc:icon-monks:v0.4.2")` from JitPack

## Docs

- [React icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/react-icons/): Typed, tree-shakeable components with an IconContext for defaults.
- [Vue icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/vue-icons/): Vue 3 components with provide/inject defaults.
- [Web components](https://www.iconmonks.co/web-components/): An `<icon-monks>` element for plain HTML, Angular, Svelte, Astro and WordPress.
- [Icon font](https://www.iconmonks.co/icon-font/): OTF and WOFF2 fonts with CSS classes in five weights.
- [SVG icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/svg-icons/): Raw SVG files, sprites, metadata and a toSvg() helper.
- [Flutter icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/flutter-icons/): IconData constants backed by bundled fonts.
- [SwiftUI icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/swiftui-icons/): A Swift package with vector assets for SwiftUI and UIKit.
- [Android icons](https://www.iconmonks.co/jetpack-compose-icons/): Jetpack Compose ImageVectors and XML VectorDrawables.
- [Get started](https://www.iconmonks.co/getting-started/)
- [Categories](https://www.iconmonks.co/categories/)
- [License](https://www.iconmonks.co/license/)
- [About Icon Monks](https://www.iconmonks.co/about/)

## Guides

- [How to use Icon Monks icons in Figma](https://www.iconmonks.co/guides/use-icons-in-figma/): Copy or download any Icon Monks icon as SVG or PDF and use it in Figma, Sketch, Illustrator or Framer as an editable vector, in any of six weights.
- [How to change icon color and size](https://www.iconmonks.co/guides/change-icon-color-and-size/): Change the color and size of Icon Monks icons in React, Vue, web components, CSS icon fonts, inline SVG, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, with code for each.
- [SVG icons vs icon fonts: which should you use?](https://www.iconmonks.co/guides/svg-vs-icon-font/): SVG icons and icon fonts compared on color, duotone, accessibility, performance and setup, with a clear recommendation for each kind of project.
- [How to choose an icon weight](https://www.iconmonks.co/guides/choose-icon-weight/): Which icon weight to use where: stroke widths, best sizes and typical uses for thin, light, regular, bold, fill and duotone icons, with examples.
- [Source code](https://github.com/designmonks-llc/icon-monks)
